title: 第11章 李恒被打第12章 找肖少
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
宋萌萌闻言，脸色也变得紧张起来，连忙点了点头，脚下加大油门，车子飞快地朝着苏氏集团的方向驶去，窗外的景物飞速倒退。
车子一路疾驰，好一会儿，终于稳稳停在了苏氏集团大门外。
陈阳和宋萌萌迫不及待地探出头，远远就看到令人怒火中烧的一幕。
只见李恒蜷缩着身子倒在地上，四周站着四男一女，正居高临下地围着他，其中那个一脸嚣张的男人，正是赵凯。
而他身边依偎着的女生，赫然是陈阳的前女友唐欣悦。
赵凯穿着一身笔挺的苏氏集团工装，皮鞋锃亮，他一脚狠狠踩着李恒的脸颊，脚掌用力碾压，眼神里满是不屑与狠厉，嘴角勾起一抹恶毒的笑意。
李恒的脸颊被踩得扭曲变形，嘴角溢着鲜血，却依旧死死咬着牙，眼神里满是不甘与愤怒，却无力反抗。
“李恒，你也不撒泡尿照照自己，就你也配替陈阳那土狗出头，来找我算账？”
赵凯居高临下地骂着，语气嚣张又恶毒：“今天我就好好教训教训你，让你知道什么叫规矩！”
陈阳看到这一幕，只觉得体内的怒火瞬间冲天，头顶的伤口都隐隐作痛，双眼赤红，浑身气得发抖，恨不得立刻冲上去将赵凯撕碎。
宋萌萌也气得脸色发白，双手紧紧攥成拳头，她连忙熄了火，推开车门就冲了出去，陈阳紧随其后。
两人像疯了一样，朝着那伙人冲了过去。
赵凯和唐欣悦等人见状，下意识有点意外。
赵凯松开踩在李恒脸上的脚，眼神警惕地看着冲过来的陈阳和宋萌萌，嘴角依旧挂着嚣张的笑意。
陈阳和宋萌萌快步冲到李恒身边，连忙蹲下身，小心翼翼地将他扶了起来。
李恒的脸上青一块紫一块，嘴角还挂着血迹，头发凌乱，眼神里满是怒火，刚一起来就挣扎着还要往赵凯那边扑，嘴里嘶吼着：“赵凯，你这个混蛋，我迟早要宰了你！
唐欣悦，你这个王八蛋，你简直是瞎了眼！”
陈阳和宋萌萌连忙死死拉住他，用力按住他的胳膊，生怕他再冲上去吃亏。
陈阳抬眸扫过赵凯身边的几个西装男，眼神一沉。
看他们的穿着和神态，应该是赵凯的下属。

他早就听说，赵凯在苏氏集团当主管，手下带着不少人，平日里在公司就嚣张跋扈，没想到竟然这么过分。
只是让陈阳有些意外的是，唐欣悦竟然会在这里。
他记得，唐欣悦是在另一家公司当文员，她怎么会跟赵凯一起出现在苏氏集团门口？
赵凯双手抱胸，居高临下地看着陈阳，语气里满是嘲讽：“陈阳，看来昨天晚上被我打得还不够惨？
现在竟然还敢带着这个废物来找我算账？”
陈阳的头还隐隐作痛，虽然激活了透视神通，但他的身体并没什么变化，现在头伤还没有完全恢复，此刻只觉得浑身无力。
陈阳强压着心底的怒火，咬着牙说：“赵凯，你给我等着，这个仇，我一定会找你算清楚！”
赵凯冷哼一声，语气不屑又恶毒：“老子就等着你，随时奉陪！
不过你下次再敢来找事，我就直接把你打成植物人，让你这辈子都站不起来！”
content_en:
When Song Mengmeng heard this, her face became nervous. She nodded quickly, stepped on the accelerator, and the car drove quickly in the direction of the Su Group, and the scenery outside the window quickly retreated.
The car sped along, and after a while, it finally stopped firmly outside the gate of Su Group.
Chen Yang and Song Mengmeng couldn't wait to poke their heads out and saw an infuriating scene from a distance.
Li Heng was seen curled up and lying on the ground. Four men and one woman were standing around him, condescendingly surrounding him. The man with an arrogant face among them was Zhao Kai.
And the girl cuddling next to him turned out to be Chen Yang's ex-girlfriend Tang Xinyue.
Zhao Kai was wearing a straight Su Group work clothes and polished leather shoes. He stepped hard on Li Heng's cheek and crushed it with the sole of his foot. His eyes were full of disdain and cruelty, and the corner of his mouth raised a vicious smile.
Li Heng's cheeks were distorted and deformed by the trampling, and blood spilled from the corners of his mouth, but he still gritted his teeth. His eyes were full of unwillingness and anger, but he was unable to resist.
"Li Heng, if you don't urinate and look after yourself, are you worthy of standing up for that bitch Chen Yang and coming to settle accounts with me?"
Zhao Kai cursed condescendingly, with an arrogant and vicious tone: "I will teach you a lesson today and let you know what the rules are!"
When Chen Yang saw this scene, he felt the anger in his body surge to the sky. The wounds on his head were aching, his eyes were red, and his whole body was shaking with anger. He wanted to rush forward and tear Zhao Kai to pieces immediately.
Song Mengmeng's face turned pale with anger, and she clenched her hands tightly into fists. She quickly turned off the engine, pushed open the car door and rushed out, followed closely by Chen Yang.
The two of them rushed towards the group like crazy.
When Zhao Kai, Tang Xinyue and others saw this, they were subconsciously surprised.
Zhao Kai released his foot from Li Heng's face and looked at Chen Yang and Song Mengmeng who were rushing over with vigilant eyes, still with an arrogant smile on his lips.
Chen Yang and Song Mengmeng rushed to Li Heng's side, quickly knelt down and carefully helped him up.
Li Heng's face was bruised and purple, with blood stains hanging from the corners of his mouth, his hair was messy, and his eyes were full of anger. As soon as he got up, he struggled to rush towards Zhao Kai, shouting: "Zhao Kai, you bastard, sooner or later I will kill you!"
Tang Xinyue, you bastard, you are simply blind! "
Chen Yang and Song Mengmeng quickly grabbed him and held down his arms, fearing that he would suffer a loss if he rushed forward again.
Chen Yang raised his eyes and glanced at the men in suits beside Zhao Kai, his eyes darkening.
Judging from their clothes and demeanor, they should be Zhao Kai's subordinates.
He had long heard that Zhao Kai was a supervisor in the Su Group and had many people under him. He was usually arrogant and domineering in the company, but he did not expect that he would go so far.
What surprised Chen Yang was that Tang Xinyue was here.
He remembered that Tang Xinyue was working as a clerk in another company. How could she appear at the door of Su Group with Zhao Kai?
Zhao Kai crossed his arms and looked at Chen Yang condescendingly, his tone full of ridicule: "Chen Yang, it seems that the beating I gave you last night wasn't bad enough?
Now you actually dare to bring this trash to me to settle a score? "
Chen Yang's head still hurts. Although his clairvoyance power has been activated, his body has not changed much. The head injury has not fully recovered yet, and he only feels weak at the moment.
Chen Yang suppressed the anger in his heart and gritted his teeth and said, "Zhao Kai, just wait for me. I will definitely settle this revenge with you!"
Zhao Kai snorted coldly, with a disdainful and vicious tone: "I am waiting for you and will be with you at any time!
But next time you dare to cause trouble, I will beat you into a vegetative state and make you unable to stand up for the rest of your life! "
